requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.quote: The vehicle’s fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning; their sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.

requirements.quote: The vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.

requirements.quote: The vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall operate in a normal manner, except that this requirement does not apply to sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.

requirements.quote: They may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the following requirements:.

requirements.quote: In the two vehicle-loading conditions the protective device between the corners, as defined in paragraph 3.1.5. of this Regulation, shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line.

requirements.quote: The vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h +0.1/-0

requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions.
requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.quote: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, in accordance with ISO 11451-2, the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, in accordance with ISO 11451-2, the field strength shall be a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, in accordance with ISO 11451-2, the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: During the tests performed in accordance with Annex 6, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" of the vehicle representative of its type, according to paragraph 2.1. of Annex 6.
requirements.quote: The vehicle representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 6, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions", according to paragraph 2.1. of Annex 6.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA broadband limit shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values of broadband electromagnetic interference, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA narrowband limit shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value of narrowband electromagnetic interference, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.

requirements.quote: Test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.

requirements.quote: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".

requirements.text: The ESA representative of this type shall be tested for immunity by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.quote: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.

requirements.quote: Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.

requirements.quote: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.

requirements.text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
requirements.quote: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.

requirements.text: The limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

requirements.quote: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered:

requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.quote: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.

requirements.quote: Orientation Toward the front.

requirements.quote: indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. by the symbol shown in Annex 7 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with light source module(s), the approval mark on the light source module and the one on the lamp in which the module is used shall be from the same applicant.
requirements.quote: The approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant;

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with light source module(s), the light source module(s) shall bear a marking indicating the rated voltage or the range of voltage, except that where the light-source module(s) is non-replaceable, it does not need to be marked.
requirements.quote: (c) The rated voltage or the range of voltage. In the case where the light-source module(s) is non-replaceable, it does not need to be marked;

requirements.quote: The approval marking shall consist of:

requirements.text: In the case an electronic light source control gear, which is part of the lamp but not included into the lamp body, is used to operate a light source or a light source module(s), the electronic light source control gear shall be marked with its specific identification code.
requirements.quote: In the case an electronic light source control gear, which is part of the lamp but not included into the lamp body, is used to operate a light source or a light source module(s), it shall be marked with its specific identification code and the rated input voltage or range of voltage;

requirements.text: In the case an electronic light source control gear, which is part of the lamp but not included into the lamp body, is used to operate a light source or a light source module(s), the electronic light source control gear shall be marked with the rated input voltage or range of voltage.
requirements.quote: In the case an electronic light source control gear, which is part of the lamp but not included into the lamp body, is used to operate a light source or a light source module(s), it shall be marked with its specific identification code and the rated input voltage or range of voltage;

requirements.text: In the case of AFS, front fog lamps and headlamps except Class AS, BS, CS, and DS meeting the requirements of Annex 7 only when supplied with a voltage of 12V, the front fog lamp shall bear a marking consisting of the Number 24 crossed out by an oblique cross (X) near the holders of the light source(s) as shown in Annex 12.
requirements.quote: In the case of AFS, front fog lamps and headlamps except Class AS, BS, CS, and DS meeting the requirements of Annex 7 only when supplied with a voltage of 12V, a marking consisting of the Number 24 crossed out by an oblique cross (X) near the holders of the light source(s) as shown in Annex 12;

requirements.text: The Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp.
requirements.quote: The Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp.

requirements.text: In any case, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.quote: In any case, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.

requirements.text: In any case, the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.quote: In any case, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on the detachable lens.
requirements.quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on the main body.
requirements.quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.quote: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.

requirements.text: In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, a single Unique Identifier or approval mark may be applied, provided that all the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps satisfy the pertinent Regulation.
requirements.quote: In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps a single Unique Identifier or approval mark may be applied, provided that all the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps satisfy the pertinent Regulation and that the following requirements are also fulfilled:

requirements.text: In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps with a single Unique Identifier or approval mark, the requirements of paragraph 3.3.2. shall apply.
requirements.quote: (a) Requirements of paragraph 3.3.2. apply;

requirements.text: In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps with a single Unique Identifier or approval mark, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.quote: (b) No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark;

requirements.text: In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps with a single Unique Identifier or approval mark, the symbols for each lamp, appropriate to each UN Regulation under which approval has been granted, shall be marked either on the appropriate light-emitting surface.
requirements.quote: (c) The symbols for each lamp, appropriate to each UN Regulation under which approval has been granted, shall be marked: (i) Either on the appropriate light-emitting surface;

requirements.text: In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps with a single Unique Identifier or approval mark, as an alternative the symbols for each lamp, appropriate to each UN Regulation under which approval has been granted, shall be marked in a group, in such a way that each lamp of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps may be clearly identified.
requirements.quote: (ii) Or in a group, in such a way that each lamp of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps may be clearly identified.

requirements.text: Lamps submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4 and 5.
requirements.quote: Lamps submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4 and 5.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations No. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to the lamps.
requirements.quote: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations No. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible, the requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied.
requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured.
requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be fitted with a device enabling them to be so adjusted on the vehicles as to comply with the rules applicable to them, except that such a device need not be fitted on units in which the reflector and the diffusing lens cannot be separated, provided the use of such units is confined to vehicles on which the lamp setting can be adjusted by other means.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall be fitted with a device enabling them to be so adjusted on the vehicles as to comply with the rules applicable to them. Such a device need not be fitted on units in which the reflector and the diffusing lens cannot be separated, provided the use of such units is confined to vehicles on which the lamp setting can be adjusted by other means.

requirements.text: In case of headlamps of classes AS, BS, CS, DS and of front fog lamps, the adjustment device may or may not provide horizontal adjustment, provided that the front fog lamps are so designed that they can maintain a proper horizontal aiming even after the vertical aiming adjustment.
requirements.quote: In case of headlamps of classes AS, BS, CS, DS and of front fog lamps, such a device may or may not provide horizontal adjustment, provided that the headlamps are so designed that they can maintain a proper horizontal aiming even after the vertical aiming adjustment.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or - light source module(s) and/or - non-replaceable light source(s).

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.quote: The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.
requirements.quote: The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed shall apply.
requirements.quote: The holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed, applies.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) shall apply.
requirements.quote: In addition, where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) applies.

requirements.text: The road illumination devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Road illumination devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.quote: (a) it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s); and

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.quote: (b) it is tamperproof; and

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not mechanically interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
requirements.quote: (c) regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not mechanically interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source; and/or,

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not mechanically interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.quote: any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the lamp or AFS system shall be met.
requirements.quote: (d) when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the lamp or AFS system shall be met.

requirements.text: If applicable, the light source modules shall comply with the requirements specified in Annex 9.
requirements.quote: If applicable, light source modules shall comply with the requirements specified in Annex 9.

requirements.text: In the case where a front fog lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In the case where a front fog lamp or a cornering lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.3 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.2 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28.0 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.3 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.2 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28.0 V (24 Volt-Systems).

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities and colorimetric characteristics shall be carried out according to Annex 10.
requirements.quote: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities and colorimetric characteristics shall be carried out according to Annex 10.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics of the front fog lamp shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.6.1. and 4.6.2.
requirements.quote: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.6.1. and 4.6.2.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of the lamp is made of plastic material, tests of the lamp shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 8.
requirements.quote: If the outer lens of the lamp is made of plastic material tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 8.

requirements.text: The UV resistance of light transmitting components located inside a front fog lamp and made of plastic material shall be tested according to Annex 8, paragraph 3.3.
requirements.quote: The UV resistance of light transmitting components located inside a front fog lamp and made of plastic material shall be tested according to Annex 8, paragraph 3.3.

requirements.text: The sharpness and linearity of the cut-off of the lamp, if applicable, shall be tested according to the requirements in Annex 6.
requirements.quote: The sharpness and linearity of the cut-off, if applicable, shall be tested according to the requirements in Annex 6.

requirements.text: Except for cornering lamps, complementary tests of the lamp shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 7 to ensure that in use there is no excessive change in photometric performance.
requirements.quote: Except for cornering lamps, complementary tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 7 to ensure that in use there is no excessive change in photometric performance.

requirements.text: The component(s) to which a replaceable light source is assembled shall be so made that the light source fits easily.
requirements.quote: The component(s) to which a replaceable light source is assembled shall be so made that the light source fits easily and, even in darkness, can be fitted in no position but the correct one.

requirements.text: The component(s) to which a replaceable light source is assembled shall be so made that the light source, even in darkness, can be fitted in no position but the correct one.
requirements.quote: The component(s) to which a replaceable light source is assembled shall be so made that the light source fits easily and, even in darkness, can be fitted in no position but the correct one.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with replaceable light sources, the lamp shall meet the requirements of paragraph 5. with at least one standard (étalon) light source, which may be submitted with the lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case of lamps with replaceable light sources, the lamp shall be considered acceptable if it meets the requirements of paragraph 5. with at least one standard (étalon) light source, which may be submitted with the lamp.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the lamps shall be white for all lamps, except that for front fog lamps the colour of the light emitted may be selective yellow if requested by the applicant.
requirements.quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be white for all lamps. However, for front fog lamps the colour of the light emitted may be selective yellow if requested by the applicant.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be aimed according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.4. including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4.
requirements.quote: The front fog lamp shall be aimed according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.4. including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4.

requirements.text: If vertical adjustment cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the allowed tolerances, the instrumental method of Annex 6, paragraph 2. shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the symmetric "cut-off" line and to perform the beam vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp.
requirements.quote: If, however, vertical adjustment cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the allowed tolerances, the instrumental method of Annex 6, paragraph 2. shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the symmetric "cut-off" line and to perform the beam vertical adjustment.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall be measured either with white light or coloured light as prescribed by the applicant for use of the fog lamp in normal service.
requirements.quote: The luminous intensity shall be measured either with white light or coloured light as prescribed by the applicant for use of the fog lamp in normal service.

requirements.text: Variations in homogeneity detrimental to satisfactory visibility in the zone above the line 5 from 10°L to 10°R shall not be permitted in the front fog lamp light distribution.
requirements.quote: Variations in homogeneity detrimental to satisfactory visibility in the zone above the line 5 from 10°L to 10°R are not permitted.

requirements.text: Inside the field between lines 1 to 5 in Figure A4-X, the beam pattern of the front fog lamp should be substantially uniform.
requirements.quote: Inside the field between lines 1 to 5 in Figure A4-X, the beam pattern should be substantially uniform.

requirements.text: Discontinuities in intensities detrimental to satisfactory visibility between the lines 6, 7, 8 and 9 shall not be permitted in the front fog lamp light distribution.
requirements.quote: Discontinuities in intensities detrimental to satisfactory visibility between the lines 6, 7, 8 and 9 are not permitted.

requirements.text: In the light-distribution as specified in Table 17, single narrow spots or stripes of the front fog lamp inside the area including the measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 may be allowed with not more than 1.75∙10² cd, only if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.
requirements.quote: In the light-distribution as specified in Table 17, single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including the measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 with not more than 1.75∙102 cd are allowed, if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.

requirements.text: If multiple spots or stripes are present in the light-distribution of the front fog lamp as specified in Table 17, the spots or stripes shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.
requirements.quote: If multiple spots or stripes are present, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.

requirements.text: Where the luminous intensities of the front fog lamp of Class F3 are automatically varied to adapt to dense fog or similar conditions of reduced visibility, an active electronic light source control gear shall be incorporated into the front fog lamp function system.
requirements.quote: (a) An active electronic light source control gear is incorporated into the front fog lamp function system;

requirements.text: Where the luminous intensities of the front fog lamp of Class F3 are automatically varied to adapt to dense fog or similar conditions of reduced visibility, all intensities shall be varied proportionately.
requirements.quote: (b) All intensities are varied proportionately.

requirements.text: When checked for compliance according to the provisions of paragraph 4.6.2.1., where the luminous intensities of the front fog lamp of Class F3 are automatically varied, the luminous intensities shall remain within 60 per cent and 100 per cent of the values specified in Table 17.
requirements.quote: The system, when checked for compliance according to the provisions of paragraph 4.6.2.1., is considered acceptable if the luminous intensities remain within 60 per cent and 100 per cent of the values specified in Table 17.

requirements.text: For front fog lamps corresponding to paragraph 5.5. of this Regulation, if not otherwise specified, no measured value shall deviate unfavorably by more than 20 per cent from the value prescribed in this Regulation, and Table 19 shall apply.
requirements.quote: For front fog lamps corresponding to paragraph 5.5. of this Regulation, Table 19 shall apply;

requirements.text: The symmetric "cut-off" line of the front fog lamp in its neutral state shall provide a straight "horizontal part" towards the left and the right (see Figure A5-II).
requirements.quote: The symmetric "cut-off" line shall provide a straight "horizontal part" towards the left and the right (see Figure A5-II)

requirements.text: In the case of a road illumination device providing a front fog lamp, the front fog lamp device shall be visually aimed by means of the "cut-off" (see Figure A5-II).
requirements.quote: In the case of a road illumination device providing a front fog lamp, the device shall be visually aimed by means of the "cut-off" (see Figure A5-II) as follows.

requirements.text: In the case of a road illumination device providing a front fog lamp, for vertical adjustment the "cut-off" of the front fog lamp shall be moved upward from below line B and adjusted to its nominal position 1 degrees below the H-H line.
requirements.quote: For vertical adjustment: the "cut-off" is moved upward from below line B and adjusted to its nominal position 1 degrees below the H-H line;

requirements.text: In the case of a road illumination device providing a front fog lamp, for horizontal adjustment the front fog lamp shall be aligned according to paragraph 3.3.1.2.
requirements.quote: For horizontal adjustment: according to paragraph 3.3.1.2.

requirements.text: When the front fog lamp is designed for use in pairs or has otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, the front fog lamp shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant, or otherwise in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.
requirements.quote: When the front fog lamp is designed for use in pairs or has otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, it shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant, or otherwise in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.

requirements.text: Where a front fog lamp aimed as described in paragraph 3. does not meet the device specific requirements set out in paragraphs 5. or 6.2. of this Regulation and its alignment is changed, the axis of the beam shall not be displaced horizontally by more than 2° to the left or to the right.
requirements.quote: (c) 2° to the left or to the right for device designed to provide a front fog lamp or a cornering lamp

requirements.text: Where a front fog lamp aimed as described in paragraph 3. does not meet the device specific requirements set out in paragraphs 5. or 6.2. of this Regulation and its alignment is changed, the axis of the beam shall not be displaced vertically by more than 0.5° up or down.
requirements.quote: (c) 0.5° up or down for device designed to provide a front fog lamp or a cornering lamp

requirements.text: If vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the tolerances described in paragraph 4.1., the instrumental method of Annex 6 shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the "cut-off" and to perform the vertical and horizontal adjustment of the beam.
requirements.quote: If, however, vertical adjustment of the device providing a passing-beam or a front fog lamp cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the tolerances described in paragraph 4.1., the instrumental method of Annex 6 shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the "cut-off" and to perform the vertical and horizontal adjustment of the beam.

requirements.text: In the case where paragraph 1.2. applies, the quality of the "cut-off" line of the front fog lamp shall be tested according to the requirements set out in paragraph 2.2.
requirements.quote: In the case where paragraph 1.2. applies, the quality of the "cut-off" line shall be tested according to the requirements set out in paragraph 2.2.

requirements.text: The "cut-off" quality shall be considered acceptable if the requirements of paragraphs 2.2.1. to 2.2.3. comply with at least one set of measurements.
requirements.quote: The "cut-off" quality shall be considered acceptable if the requirements of paragraphs 2.2.1. to 2.2.3. comply with at least one set of measurements.

requirements.text: Not more than one "cut-off" shall be visible of the front fog lamp.
requirements.quote: Not more than one "cut-off" shall be visible

requirements.text: The sharpness factor G of the front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line shall be determined by scanning vertically through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" at 2.5° left and right from the V-V line, where G = (log Eβ - log E(β + 0.1°)), β being the vertical position in degrees and E the illumination on the aiming screen.
requirements.quote: (b) 2.5° left and right from the V-V line for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line where: G = (log Eβ - log E(β + 0.1°))

requirements.text: The value of G shall not be less than 0.08 (minimum sharpness) for the front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line.
requirements.quote: (b) 0.08 (minimum sharpness) for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line

requirements.text: For the front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line, the part of the horizontal "cut-off" shall be horizontal between 3° left and right from the V-V line (see Figure A6-II).
requirements.quote: (b) For passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line the part of the horizontal "cut-off" shall be horizontal between 3° left and right from the V-V line (see Figure A6-II).

requirements.text: The maximum vertical distance between the inflection points determined shall not exceed 0.5° for the front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line.
requirements.quote: (b) 0.5° for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line

requirements.text: For vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line, a vertical scan shall be carried out, moving upward from below the line B, through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" on the V-V line (see Figure A6-II).
requirements.quote: (b) on the V-V line for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line (see Figure A6-II)

requirements.text: For vertical adjustment, the inflection point (where d2 (log E) / dβ2 = 0) shall be determined and positioned on the line B situated 1° below H-H line for front fog lamp.
requirements.quote: (b) 1° below H-H line for front fog lamp

requirements.text: For horizontal adjustment of the front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line, the cut-off line shall be so positioned that the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical to the V-V line.
requirements.quote: The cut-off line shall be so positioned that the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical to the V-V line.

requirements.text: In case of front fog lamps designed for use in pairs or having otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, the "cut-off" line shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant, or otherwise in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.
requirements.quote: In case of front fog lamps designed for use in pairs or has otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, the “cut-off” line shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant, or otherwise in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.

requirements.text: Once the photometric values have been measured according to this Regulation, in the case of front fog lamps, the stability of photometric performance shall be tested at the point of maximum illumination in zone D (Imax) and in the point HV.
requirements.quote: (c) In the case of front fog lamps: at the point of maximum illumination in zone D (Imax) and in the point HV;

requirements.text: A complete sample of the front fog lamp shall be tested for stability of photometric performance in operation.
requirements.quote: A complete sample shall be tested for stability of photometric performance in operation.

requirements.text: The stability of photometric performance tests shall be carried out in a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C, the test sample being mounted on a base representing the correct installation on the vehicle.

regulations.rationale: The bumper forms the lower-leg impact zone, which R127 pedestrian safety tests on M1 vehicles. (lexical: term match score 8.2)
The bumper is the front protective device on an M1 vehicle and must pass R42's low-speed collision test. (lexical: term match score 2.4)
The ultrasonic parking sensors and wiring are an electronic sub-assembly, so R10 electromagnetic compatibility applies. (lexical: term match score 8.5)
R48 governs how the fog and position lamps are installed on an M1 vehicle. (lexical: term match score 7.9)
R149 is the current device regulation for approving the built-in front fog lamp. (lexical: term match score 7.3)
R148 is the current device regulation for approving the built-in front position lamp. (lexical: term match score 2.4)
The bumper is outer bodywork of an M1 car, so it must meet R26 limits on external projections. (lexical: term match score 5.7)
GTR 9 sets the same lower-leg impact test for the bumper as R127, so it is relevant to this part. (lexical: term match score 14.0)
R19 is the older front fog lamp regulation, now combined into R149, so R149 is cited instead. (lexical: term match score 1.0; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
R7 is the older front position lamp regulation, now combined into R148, so R148 is cited instead. (lexical: term match score 0.5; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
R128 covers replaceable LED bulbs, not lamps with built-in LEDs, and the product does not mention such bulbs. (lexical: term match score 0.2)
R37 covers filament bulbs, and the product does not say which light source its lamps use. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
R175 approves the vehicle's pedal-error acceleration control system; parking sensors may feed it, but the bumper is not that system. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Frontal collision protection covers occupant restraint in a crash test of the whole vehicle, not the bumper as a part. (lexical: term match score 0.7)
The product has no retro-reflectors, and R3 is replaced by R150 anyway. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
R137 covers the occupant restraint system, which is not part of the bumper. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
The product has no retro-reflective devices. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Emergency braking is a separate vehicle system, not a function of the bumper. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
